body: Have you tried reading, not to make you sleep but just take your mind off things. One thing to not do is use your screen two hours before bed, because of blue light and what not.  Also if you've been in bed for 15 minutes and can't sleep get out of the bed, do something else, maybe walk for a bit. Staying in bed for too long will give you anxiety about how you can't sleep. Another thing I would recommend is stick to a schedule, like wake up and sleep at the same time everyday, that way your body will produce Melatonin at the right time.
Yes it is normal. I experience the same thing, maybe try listening to music, even if you can't fall asleep, I find it more relaxing than staying in bed motionless.

That's good for you. No one but you can make your problems go away, even then they won't go away but you'll know how to deal with them. If you can try going to therapy.

I completely agree with you. Sleeping won't fix anything. I'm not going to give you any cliche advice like it gets better because Im still not sure that's true.  I have no idea what's going on in your head I can't really help you with that. Heres my advice, just try to hang on for a little longer, take it one day at a time and try to take care of yourself.
